name: ALTCHA
description: Provides a free, open-source Captcha alternative utilizing a proof-of-work mechanism to safeguard your website against spam and unwanted content.
project_description:
ALTCHA provides a free, open-source Captcha alternative utilizing a proof-of-work mechanism to safeguard your website against spam and unwanted content. ALTCHA ensures robust spam protection without compromising user privacy.

 Back to top 

 Integrations supported 
 
 Self-hosted 
 Sentinel 
 SaaS API (deprecated) 
 
 Back to top 

 Post-Installation 
 
 Configure ALTCHA globally on the CAPTCHA configuration form via: /admin/config/people/captcha 
 Configure ALTCHA on specific forms via: /admin/config/people/captcha/captcha-points 
 Users with the administer altcha permission can configure ALTCHA via: /admin/config/people/captcha/altcha 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module depends on the CAPTCHA module.

 Back to top 

 Additional features 
 ALTCHA Obfuscate 
 This feature provides support for the obfuscation mode of the ALTCHA widget, and helps protect sensitive information from bots. 

 The submodule adds obfuscation field formatters for e-mail, telephone and text fields.

 Back to top 

 Versioning 
 There are currently 2 supported branches:

 
 1.x : ALTCHA v2 widget. View specific configuration docs here . 
 2.x : ALTCHA v3 widget with improved algorithm and additional display options. View specific configuration docs here . 
 
 Back to top 

 Alternative modules 
 Friendly Captcha - Alternative proof-of-work CAPTCHA solution.

 CAPTCHA - See the list of other CAPTCHA modules.

 Back to top
